<!--
This page auto-populates from every .qmd file inside /projects that has
front matter (title, description, date, categories, image) and is not
marked `draft: true`.

The category chips above the grid come straight from each project's
`categories:` field — that's how "Academic" vs "Personal", or "Report" vs
"Presentation" vs "Dashboard", become clickable filters with zero extra
config. Keep category naming consistent across projects (see
_templates/README.md) or the filters fragment into near-duplicates.

Add a new project = drop a new .qmd file in /projects. Nothing to edit here.
-->
